sections.title: ✨ New Features
items: On-premises support: Added support for on-premises Dynamics 365 environments with MSCRMCalledId header
Lookup hyperlinks: Added clickable links in All Fields table to navigate directly to lookup records (#430)

sections.title: 🔧 Improvements
items: Migrated from session rules to dynamic rules for better impersonation persistence
Improved impersonation UI: Removed Stop button, keeping only Reset for clearer user experience
Enhanced state management: Impersonation state is now tracked per environment URL instead of per tab

sections.title: 🐛 Bug Fixes
items: Fixed impersonation clearing on page refresh. Should still use Ctrl+Shift+R for hard refresh
